_comment: WO-1958. COPY THIS FILE to reown.config.json (gitignored) and paste the Project ID from https://dashboard.reown.com/. Then run `npm run web:bundle`, which reads it and writes the gitignored reown-config.js shim that index.html loads. A projectId is a PUBLIC client identifier - it is kept out of git because it is account-specific, not because it is a secret. With no projectId the Jupiter Mobile door REFUSES BY NAME (reason=no-project-id) and the Solflare/Phantom handoff from WO-1957 is unaffected.
_console_steps: 2. Create project -> name it (e.g. Echoes of Elarion)

4. Project URL: the live origin that will serve the game (https://defenders-webgl.vercel.app, and the production domain when that is the one that ships) - AppKit sends this origin in its metadata and Reown checks it
5. Project settings -> copy Project ID into the projectId field below
